facts.fact: Mozambique's INGD says its digital register of humanitarian aid recipients, being tested in Beira and due to launch in October 2026 at a WFP-stated cost of about 20 million meticais, is to interoperate with the database of the social action institute INAS so the two show who has received food aid.
